verdict.rationale: Baseten exposes broad API/CLI surface for core workflows—deploying models (Truss config.yaml, no Dockerfile), running inference (OpenAI-compatible endpoints, streaming, async, function calling), training (Loops/Training Jobs API), and usage/billing queries by API key or model—suggesting most UI actions have API equivalents. However, some account-management actions (e.g., raising Basic account limits or upgrading to Pro/Enterprise) explicitly require an email-verification web form rather than an API call, and no public OpenAPI spec was found (probe returned 404s), so full parity isn't documented or verifiable. Missing for 10: an explicit statement/documentation of full UI-API parity, a discoverable OpenAPI/swagger spec, and confirmation that account/billing-tier changes can be done via API rather than a web form.
